- Dual Airbags & ABS 🛡️: Prioritize your safety with advanced protection features.

✅ Exceptional fuel efficiency of 22.9 km/l, saving you money and reducing environmental impact.  
✅ Space and comfort 🛋️: UV-cut glass, tilt and telescopic steering, and ample storage for a luxurious ride.  
✅ Powerful yet smooth performance: A 1.2-liter VVT petrol engine delivering 88 bhp for an energetic yet refined drive.  

Your interest, curiosity, and satisfaction with the Baleno’s features speak volumes about your great taste! With its advanced technology, safety, and comfort, this car is designed to exceed expectations.  

We’re thrilled to see you’ve booked a test drive! 🥳 Imagine experiencing the Baleno’s smooth handling, cutting-edge features, and premium feel firsthand. Our team will ensure your visit is unforgettable. Feel free to reach out to us for any assistance!  

Looking forward to seeing you behind the wheel soon! 🚘✨
